subject.title: Per-account native command prefix for multi-agent slash commands

question: Should Slack multi-account native slash commands be solved with validated account-level nativeNames mapping, constrained nativePrefix sugar, or documented as unsupported for duplicate native command names?
rationale: Current main has no account-level naming contract, and the two closed implementation attempts show a real product/API fork that expands Slack account config and native command behavior.

options.title: Implement Validated NativeNames
options.body: Add an explicit per-account mapping surface with Slack-name format validation, duplicate checks, registration and reverse lookup support, docs, and tests.

options.title: Implement Constrained NativePrefix
options.body: Add prefix sugar with strict lowercase slug validation and no broad dash-stripping fallback, accepting simpler setup but a second naming abstraction.

options.title: Document Unsupported Duplicates
options.body: Leave runtime unchanged and document that multiple Slack apps in one workspace must not register identical native command names.

recommendation.title: Implement Validated NativeNames
recommendation.body: Add an explicit per-account mapping surface with Slack-name format validation, duplicate checks, registration and reverse lookup support, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available history across the current Slack native-command alias, shared command registry, and plugin command refactor surfaces.
